entities.name: Kiingal
entities.description: A large port on the northern coast of Zhalfir, the northernmost bastion of Zhalfirin rule.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: A landmass phased out of Dominaria and later returned to the multiverse.

entities.name: Ki'pamu
entities.description: The capital of Zhalfir, connected to Kiingal by a river.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased out north-western Jamuraa to spare it from the Phyrexian Invasion; his spirit was later shunted to Zhalfir.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: The character who destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Dominaria by Phyrexia, which Teferi phased out Zhalfir to avoid.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The later Phyrexian invasion after which Zhalfir was returned to the multiverse.

entities.name: Wrenn and Realmbreaker
entities.description: Named as the agent that returned Zhalfir by switching its place with New Phyrexia.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian-ruled plane whose place Zhalfir's landmass took.

events.summary: Kiingal is phased out with north-western Jamuraa because Teferi wants to spare it from the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Kiingal was phased out alongside the rest of north-western Jamuraa

events.summary: Kiingal is lost from Dominaria for good after Jeska destroys the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.
events.quote: It was forever lost from Dominaria after Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

events.summary: Teferi's spirit is shunted to Zhalfir, travels to Kiingal and settles in a satellite village as its Shaper Guildmage.
events.quote: eventually settling in a satellite village 12 miles to its east as its Shaper Guildmage

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Wrenn and Realmbreaker returns Zhalfir to the multiverse by swapping places with New Phyrexia.
events.quote: returned the phased out Zhalfir to the multiverse by switching the landmass' place with that of New Phyrexia

relations.quote: is the northernmost bastion of Zhalfirin rule
